picks.title: AX – Google's Open Agentic Orchestrator
picks.why_it_matters: Google open-sourcing agentic infrastructure signals a platform shift that will spawn new startups building vertical AI agents, while potentially commoditizing current orchestration plays.

picks.title: Samsung is expected to more than double output of its HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM
picks.why_it_matters: Expanded HBM4 supply could ease GPU constraints for AI startups, lowering compute costs and enabling more capital-efficient model training for early-stage companies.

picks.title: ScrollEd wants to turn textbooks into TikTok
picks.why_it_matters: Student founders tackling edtech with a mobile-native, short-form content approach represents a generational bet on how Gen Z and Gen Alpha will consume educational content.
